summary: The customer wants to know how to turn off the daily horoscope push notification.
kb_quote:
To manage notifications:
1. Open Profile → Notifications.
2. Toggle "Daily horoscope" on or off.

drafts.formal:
Hello [Customer name],

You can turn off the daily horoscope push notification in the app. Open Profile → Notifications, then toggle “Daily horoscope” off. If you continue receiving notifications, please also check your device’s system notification settings for the app.

Best regards,
[Agent name]
drafts.empathetic:

Warmly,

drafts.short: Open Profile → Notifications, then toggle “Daily horoscope” off. If notifications persist, check the app’s notification permissions in your device settings.
